Settings

Mirror front camerasaves selfies how you see them
Shutter sound
Sun glowsoft glow off the sun n bright lights. streak adds the light beam
Save sizeera = the size that phone really saved at. 1080 = hd
Themegrind = black, white grunge n graffiti, 2003 skate game style. classic = 2012 iphone leather n wood
Film develop timedisposable + 35mm: get your prints right away, or wait like a real photo lab
Back up your Rollsaves every pic n vid into one file you can keep anywhere. restore puts them all back
Yama TV logothe lil spinning TV in the corner of every video you record
Soft skinthe camera softens pores n texture on skin a lil, but keeps eyes, lips n hair sharp
Grind colorthe accent color on the grind theme
Mac booththe computer webcam version
